title: The Beginning
subtitle: Enrolment & Entry into the Legal Profession
description: The journey began in 1997, with enrolment as an advocate with the Bar Council. With determination and a commitment to the profession, the foundation of a lifelong journey in law was laid.

title: Learning from Experience
subtitle: Tis Hazari Courts
description: The initial two years were spent working under a senior advocate at Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi, gaining valuable courtroom experience and developing a strong foundation in litigation and advocacy.

title: Establishing an Independent Practice
subtitle: Chamber at Tis Hazari
description: After gaining experience under senior guidance, an independent chamber was established at Tis Hazari Courts in association with professional colleagues.
During this phase, the practice also began handling matters connected with the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) through the MCD panel.

title: Building a Strong Litigation Practice
subtitle: Tis Hazari Courts
description: Over the following decade, the practice developed a strong presence at Tis Hazari Courts, establishing its reputation for committed courtroom representation and client-focused legal service — particularly in:

title: Expansion to Karkardooma
subtitle: A New Chapter
description: The next major milestone came with the allotment of a chamber at Karkardooma Courts.
This marked the beginning of a wider practice extending beyond a single court complex and into different districts of Delhi.

title: Expanding Across Delhi’s District Courts
subtitle: Growing Reach, Growing Practice
description: The practice expanded across Delhi’s major district courts — Karkardooma, Patiala House, Dwarka, Rohini, Rouse Avenue and Tis Hazari.
With an expanding team of associates, the scope of legal practice also broadened to include:

title: Expansion into the Delhi High Court
subtitle: Taking the Practice to the High Court
description: With years of experience in trial-court litigation, the practice expanded into the Delhi High Court, increasingly focusing on matters involving:

title: From Individual Practice to a Professional Legal Team
subtitle: Singla & Singla Law Firm
description: What began as one advocate’s professional journey gradually evolved into a structured legal practice supported by a dedicated team of associates and professionals.

Today, Singla & Singla Law Firm provides legal assistance, litigation services and legal consultancy across a broad range of matters, with representation before Delhi’s District Courts and the Delhi High Court.

title: Continuing the Legacy
subtitle: Experience. Integrity. Commitment.
description: After nearly three decades of legal practice, the journey continues with the same commitment with which it began in 1997 — to provide dedicated legal representation, practical legal advice and professional assistance to every client.
